read.thesis: Q1 sales €8.8bn, GM 53.0%, and 2026 sales guide €36–40bn with GM 51–53%; order intake called "very strong" with customers accelerating capacity expansion, but no capex or capacity figures were given.

triggers.label: Customers accelerating capacity expansion
triggers.quote: our customers are accelerating their capacity expansion plans for 2026 and beyond
triggers.highlight: customers are accelerating their capacity expansion plans

triggers.label: 2026 sales guide €36–40bn
